scores.claim_text: Desert Environmental developed two non-hazardous oilfield reclamation and solid waste disposal facilities on LandBridge's land, completed/operational in Q1 2024.
scores.M_check: epa_frs.query_facilities facility_name='Desert Environmental' (and broad 'Desert' / 'reclamation' / 'oilfield') in TX and NM, filtered to Delaware-Basin counties (Loving/Winkler/Reeves/Pecos/Ward/Andrews/Lea).
scores.M_value: 0 facilities registered under 'Desert Environmental' in TX or NM. Broad 'Desert' substring returns 68 TX noise hits, none matching a Desert Environmental waste/reclamation site in the relevant Permian counties. 'reclamation' (n=80) and 'oilfield' (n=208) Permian-county subsets show only unrelated operators (Battery Reclamation, Baker Hughes, etc.).
scores.interpretation: Affiliate-operated non-hazardous oilfield reclamation/solid-waste facilities claimed completed only in Q1 2024. EPA FRS does cover oilfield-waste/landfill sites, so a permitted facility would be expected to appear eventually, but FRS registration commonly lags a few months for newly-completed sites and the permitted-site name need not match the affiliate operating-entity name 'Desert Environmental LLC'. Two real reclamation facilities (Pecos/Reeves) do exist in the right basin under other names. Treated as a ceiling-vs-shown timing gap on a freshly-operational affiliate facility, not a benign-explanation-free absence -> MODERATE, not SEVERE.

scores.claim_text: WaterBridge operates an integrated produced-water network on LandBridge's land (~600,000 bpd existing capacity; 174 facilities aggregate) and is one of LandBridge's largest customers (14% of 2023 revenue).
scores.M_check: epa_frs.query_facilities facility_name='WaterBridge' in TX and NM; cross-checked with edgar_fts external counterparty validation.
scores.M_value: EPA FRS TX: 1 facility 'WATERBRIDGE TEXAS OPERATING - FORTUNE SWD FACILITY', Orla, Reeves County TX (a saltwater-disposal facility in the Delaware Basin). EDGAR FTS: 123 filings across multiple E&P/midstream filers (Centennial Resource Development, NGL Energy Partners, PDC Energy) mention 'WaterBridge'.
scores.interpretation: WaterBridge is independently corroborated as a real, EPA-permitted Delaware-Basin produced-water operator (Orla/Reeves is squarely in LandBridge's footprint) and is widely disclosed by third-party operators. The shared-sponsor counterparty exists and operates physical water-handling assets in the claimed region. Capacity bpd figures are not separately registry-quantifiable, but facility existence + operator reality are corroborated -> PASS.

scores.claim_text: Through subsidiaries DBR Solar and Pecos Renewables, LandBridge is obtaining permits for two solar facilities (330 MW aggregate) on its Southern Position, with a third 120 MW location identified.
scores.M_check: epa_frs.query_facilities facility_name='Pecos Renewables' / 'DBR Solar' in TX.
scores.M_value: 0 EPA-FRS facilities under either subsidiary name. (Solar generation is not an EPA-permitted process category and 'obtaining permits' is explicitly pre-construction.)
scores.interpretation: Claim is explicitly forward/planned ('we are obtaining permits', 'identified a third location') -> per Calibration Heuristic 3, planned/under-permitting projects are tracked as forward, not as a current obligation, so absence is not underdelivery. No federal registry covers state/local solar siting permits in TX, and EPA FRS is the wrong registry for solar generation -> honestly UNVERIFIABLE rather than manufactured severity.

scores.claim_text: LandBridge's management formed a WaterBridge-Devon Energy joint venture for additional produced-water infrastructure, from which LandBridge earns royalties.
scores.M_check: edgar_fts.query_fulltext 'WaterBridge' restricted to Devon Energy (CIK 0001090012); plus unrestricted external validation.
scores.M_value: Devon Energy filings: 4 hits mentioning 'WaterBridge' before cutoff. Unrestricted: 123 filings across E&P/midstream filers mention WaterBridge.
scores.interpretation: Named counterparty Devon Energy independently discloses WaterBridge in its own SEC filings, and WaterBridge is a broadly-disclosed Permian water-midstream operator. The WaterBridge<->Devon produced-water relationship is corroborated in the public record at the IPO date. LandBridge's specific royalty cut is an affiliate arrangement not separately disclosed by Devon, but the underlying JV/relationship is real -> PASS.

scores.claim_text: LandBridge owns approximately 220,000 surface acres in the Permian/Delaware Basin (TX and NM) after the May 2024 Acquisitions.
scores.M_check: edgar_fts.query_fulltext 'LandBridge' (10-K/10-Q/8-K/DEF 14A) for external corroboration of the entity/holdings.
scores.M_value: 4 EDGAR FTS hits for 'LandBridge', all unrelated filers (MGO Global, Pacific Green Technologies) — no third-party corroboration of acreage. No federal registry records aggregate private surface-acreage ownership.
scores.interpretation: Surface-acreage totals are not recorded in any federal registry (county deed records, not EDGAR/EPA/USPTO). The May 2024 acquisitions (~137k acres for ~$402M) are documented in the audited carve-out financials (East Stateline Ranch, $360M + $41.8M) within the prospectus itself, which is internally consistent, but no independent M-source covers the headline acreage -> honestly UNVERIFIABLE.

scores.claim_text: LandBridge entered sand-lease agreements with a large investment-grade E&P company and another customer to construct sand mines on its acreage, generating sand and source-water royalties.
scores.M_value: Counterparty is unnamed ('a large, investment-grade E&P company') so no targeted registry query is possible; sand-lease/royalty arrangements are not federally registered. EPA FRS does not index frac-sand surface-mine leases by lessor.
scores.interpretation: The claim names no specific external entity (per Extract rubric this is low-discriminative) and no registry covers private mineral/sand-lease royalty arrangements. Cannot be independently corroborated or contradicted -> UNVERIFIABLE.

scores.claim_text: LandBridge is pursuing surface-use payments from crypto mining, data centers, power storage and commercial fueling on its land (does not own/operate the projects).
scores.M_value: No relevant external EDGAR hits (4 unrelated filers). No named counterparty in the filing; explicitly described as opportunities being 'identified and pursued', not contracted.
scores.interpretation: Per Calibration Heuristic 3, this is an explicitly forward pipeline ('identified and are currently pursuing opportunities') with no named counterparty and no quantified executed milestone -> not a current obligation; absence of registry footprint is expected. UNVERIFIABLE, not underdelivery.
